messages.subject: legend title positioning when legend.position="bottom"?
parts:
Dear ggplot2-expeRts,

I am struggling with a bar plot:

library(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(Year=rep(2001:2010,3), Number=sample(x=1:100,
size=3*10, replace=TRUE),
Group=rep(1:3, each=10))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Year, y=Number, fill=Group)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity",
position="stack", binwidth=1) +
opts(aspect.ratio=1/2, title="My title", xlab="My xlab", ylab="My
ylab",
legend.position="bottom", legend.direction="horizontal")

(1) Is it possible to get the legend title right to the left of the
legend keys?
[so vertically aligned with the legend text] This would need less
vertical space
since the legend (including the legend title) is then just "one line".
(2) Is it possible to set "xlab" and "ylab" (in some way) in opts
[without labs()]?

Many thanks & cheers,

Marius
